honesty: Rejected strikes (used = false) and jams are kept and marked. The site shows the verdicts; it does not hide data.
A clipped strike railed the amplifier, so its peak and pp are CENSORED LOWER BOUNDS, not measurements.
The line below 100 Hz is electrical pickup, never a drum mode.
Peaks other than the fundamental are under study, not confirmed mode identifications.

101 cells, not 124: the four mountings share the x = 0 and y = 0 strips on purpose (they are the cross-mounting anchors), so the 124 (mounting, cell) pairs the campaign visited land on 101 distinct places on the membrane.

The mode maps on this site are the simple per-cell band amplitude (mean |F| over +-12 Hz). The poster figure uses the masked rank-1 factorisation, which also glues the sensor stations together; the two agree in shape, not in scale.
